name: Imported Island Example
description: Example of terrain-sampled routing, mesh-footprint water hazards, and source baked lightmaps. Use preserveLightmaps only when the scene bundle includes the referenced maps; when true, the loader preserves lightmap indices without querying Unity's IL2CPP LightmapData array. Static-batched renderers keep authored collision and their per-renderer culling bounds because the shared batch mesh spans unrelated objects. Layout sampling rejects roof/building/house surfaces by collider hierarchy name and checks for overhead floors from above and below while keeping colliders intact as obstacles. A completed in-bounds lie mistakenly moved above the settled disc may be corrected to nearby physical support; verify the results in game. Hidden base terrain is excluded from DGM physics by disabling its SurfaceMapper through the normal component lifecycle and detaching hidden cached disc terrain references. Mesh ground state uses the nearest physical imported support, including roofs and bridges. The loader does not clamp disc positions or relocate completed throws. Original base terrain sources are restored at cleanup. The city-top snap fix is user-confirmed and needs no per-map setting. Ordinary rendering ports the recognized source PBR Lit shader to native URP Lit with textures, UVs, cutouts and transparency preserved; source packed detail layers are omitted. Explicit unlit/fallback modes take precedence. Original material state is restored at cleanup. Lighting appearance still needs manual acceptance. When target distances cannot be met, remaining holes may use other grounded pairs at least 8 m apart. After placement the in-round HUD shows the measured hole par and distance. The loader requires every configured hole to have a usable DGM tee/basket; if a ground placement is unavailable or setup fails, it rolls back temporary scene changes and unloads the imported map.
